desc_pop: Bots per generation. More = accurate but slower.
desc_rounds: Generations to train. More = better result.
desc_episode: Duration of one episode in seconds (at 1x).
desc_episode_increment: How many seconds the episode grows each round.
desc_speed: Game speed (1x-3x). 4x and above breaks the game.
desc_top_percent: Share of best bots carried to next generation (0.1 = 10%).
lang_applied: Language changed: {name}. Restart for full effect.
help_intro: KC Bot — evolutionary bot for Kingdom: Classic. Controls only the king (A/D/Shift/S).
how_it_works_text: The bot uses a genetic algorithm: each bot has a genome (neural net weights). Each round bots play an episode and earn fitness (points for actions). Best genomes are selected (elitism), crossed and mutated to create a new generation. Repeats for rounds.
game_dir_missing: Game folder is missing or has no Kingdom.exe
game_dir_not_found: Game not found automatically - pick the folder manually
